🧠 錯覺記憶

"你一個人。你很確定。對嗎？"

False Memory是一款微妙的心理恐怖模組，強化了《Minecraft》中孤寂的氛圍。沒有怪物需要戰鬥、沒有跳嚇需要躲避——只有某種「哪裡不對勁」的感覺愈來愈強烈。

This mod adds ambient unease to your survival or exploration experience without disrupting the core Minecraft gameplay loop. Designed to keep you questioning what's real and what you remember, it amplifies Minecraft's quiet loneliness through subtle environmental storytelling.

Whether you're deep in a mineshaft or building peacefully on the surface, False Memory lurks beneath the surface of your perception—quiet, atmospheric, and unforgettable.

🎧 最佳體驗搭配：

  • 耳機

  • 沉浸式的小量模組

  • 一個全新的世界……或者一個你认为你已經很熟悉的舊世界
    可能需要 Fabric API： https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/fabric-api
